{{Quote|Heta's come out of hiding. Hidden Chain strikes teams are moving on targets across the galaxy, all at once.|Jekiah Ordo|<ref name="TOR:RtN" />}}
During the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian Civil War]] between the [[Mandalorian Trat'ade]] and the [[Hidden Chain]] splinter faction, Hidden Chain forces engaged in a series of raids across the galaxy.<ref name="TOR:RtN" /> The objective was to capture [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals that could be converted into soldiers via [[Darth Nul's holocron]].<ref name="Defiance" />
